description: A quantiser that snaps an incoming pitch to the nearest of the twelve notes you leave switched on

params.text: Shifts the output by whole octaves, -5 to 5
Shifts the incoming pitch by 0 to 12 semitones before it is snapped
Switched on, that note is one the pitch can be snapped to; switched off it is skipped

inputs.text: Sets the octave shift, one octave per volt, and overrides the octave knob while patched; the knob moves to follow it
Sets the semitone shift, one semitone per volt, and overrides the semitone knob while patched; the knob moves to follow it
The pitch to be snapped, at a volt per octave

outputs.text: Carries the snapped pitch, at a volt per octave

notes: the output does not move at all while nothing is patched to the pitch input
all twelve notes come up switched on, which passes the pitch through at the nearest semitone
switching every note off leaves the output stuck around ten volts above the octave setting, because the code has no note to fall back on

inputs.2: 1V per octave · continuous · one channel only

outputs.0: 1V per octave · stepped · one channel only
